The Duolingo English Test is now accepted by many universities in the USA for undergraduate and postgraduate admissions. For 2027 applicants, this matters more than it may first seem. A student who misses an IELTS date, lives far from a test centre, or needs English test results quickly can often use Duolingo as a faster route to complete their application.

The short answer is simple: many US universities accept Duolingo, but the required score is not the same everywhere.

Duolingo score requirements at US universities can range from around 95 to 135+, depending on the university, programme level, and admission policy. Some public universities start around 95–110, while selective institutions may look for 120, 130, 135, or higher; others do not publish a fixed DET minimum.

According to the official Duolingo English Test website, the test is accepted by 6,500+ institutions worldwide, takes around one hour, and results are usually available in two days. Still, one detail matters: universities can set their own English proficiency rules. Always check both the university admissions page and the official Duolingo accepting institutions portal before applying.

Here’s the thing. Getting a Duolingo score is only half the job. Choosing the right universities for that score is where many students make mistakes.

A Duolingo score can help you apply faster, especially when deadlines are close. But it should not be treated as a universal replacement for IELTS or TOEFL. Some universities accept DET for most programmes, some accept it only for selected departments, and a few may still prefer IELTS or TOEFL for specific courses.

That is why this guide is organised by score range, programme level, and university type.

Duolingo Accepted Universities in USA for Masters

Many universities in the USA accept Duolingo for master’s programmes, including popular MS courses in the USA, MBA, engineering, public health, business, data science, and other graduate courses. At postgraduate level, DET policies are often more programme-specific because individual graduate schools and departments can set their own English proficiency rules.

A mildly surprising point: a master’s programme at a less famous university can sometimes ask for a higher Duolingo score than a better-known undergraduate programme. Programme fit matters more than brand name here.

A student applying for a bachelor’s in business at Arizona State University with a 105 DET score may meet the general English requirement. The same student applying to Columbia, Cornell, or NYU would need to think differently. The target score changes with the target university.

Community Colleges Accepting Duolingo Scores

Many community colleges accept Duolingo scores, and their score requirements are often lower than those of highly selective universities.

How to Check If a US University Accepts Duolingo

Before you apply, verify the requirement yourself. Policies change, and admission pages get updated more often than many blog posts.

Follow this simple process:

  1. Go to the official university admissions website.
  2. Search for “English proficiency requirements”.
  3. Check whether Duolingo English Test is listed with IELTS and TOEFL.
  4. Look for programme-specific rules, especially for graduate, STEM, MBA, nursing, health science, or teaching-related programmes.
  5. Search the university name on the official Duolingo accepting institutions page.
  6. Email the admissions office if the information is unclear.

This may feel like extra work, but it protects you. A university may accept DET generally but not for one specific school or department.

How to Send Duolingo Scores to US Universities

Sending Duolingo scores is usually simple. After your result is available, log in to your Duolingo English Test account and send your score directly to the universities you selected.

Here is the usual process:

  1. Log in to your Duolingo English Test account.
  2. Open your certified test result.
  3. Choose “Send Results”.
  4. Search for the university or institution name.
  5. Select the correct campus, department, or programme if options appear.
  6. Submit the score.
  7. Keep confirmation for your records.

Duolingo allows students to send results digitally, which is one reason it has become popular among international applicants. Still, send your score before the deadline. Do not wait until the final day, especially if your application portal needs time to mark the English requirement as complete.

Duolingo can be the most convenient option, but IELTS and TOEFL still have wider traditional recognition in some departments. You can also compare US universities that accept PTE if you want another English test option. If your target universities all accept Duolingo, DET can save time and money. If even one key programme does not accept it, you may still need IELTS or TOEFL.

If you are applying to a top university, do not aim only for the minimum. A slightly higher score can make your application feel safer, especially when the rest of your profile is still developing.

Important Tips Before Applying with Duolingo

Check the university’s official requirement before paying the application fee. This sounds basic, but many students skip it and rely on old screenshots or third-party lists.

Also, compare your DET score with your programme level. A 105 may work for an undergraduate programme at one university, while a master’s in data science at another university may expect 120 or more.

If your score is below the requirement by 5 points, do not guess. Email admissions. Some universities allow conditional admission, while others follow the score rule strictly.

And if your deadline is close, Duolingo’s fast result time can help. The official Duolingo site says results are usually available in two days, which makes it useful when IELTS or TOEFL dates are not convenient.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do universities in the USA accept Duolingo?

Yes, many universities in the USA accept the Duolingo English Test for international admissions. Acceptance depends on the university, programme, and intake. Always verify the exact requirement before applying.

What is the minimum Duolingo score for USA universities?

There is no single minimum Duolingo score for US universities. Current published examples in this guide range from 95 to 135+, while some institutions do not publish a fixed DET minimum. Always check the exact university and programme requirement for 2027 entry before applying.

Which universities accept Duolingo in USA for masters?

Several US graduate schools accept Duolingo, but requirements are programme-specific. Current examples include Arizona State University, the University of Texas at Arlington, Kent State University, Vanderbilt University and the University of Washington. Some graduate schools, including Harvard Griffin GSAS, Yale GSAS and the University of Maryland Graduate School, use other English-proficiency tests instead.

Is Duolingo accepted in USA without IELTS?

Yes, many US universities accept Duolingo as an alternative to IELTS or TOEFL. However, not every university or programme accepts it, so check the official English proficiency page before applying and review USA study options without IELTS if you want alternative English test routes.

Which US universities accept Duolingo 100?

Some universities and admission routes accept scores around 100. Examples include Kent State University and the University of North Texas at 100, the University of Texas at Arlington at 100 for general admission, and Temple’s Bridge route at 100–105. Arizona State University’s general undergraduate requirement starts at 95.

Which US universities accept Duolingo 120?

A 120 score meets MIT’s published minimum and aligns with Yale’s competitive guidance, but it falls below some other selective benchmarks. Cornell and Brown use 130-level benchmarks, while Columbia and UCLA use 135-level minimum or competitive guidance. Always check the exact institution before applying.

How long is the Duolingo English Test score valid?

Duolingo English Test scores are generally valid for two years. If your score expires before your application deadline, you may need to retake the test.

Can I send Duolingo scores to multiple universities?

Yes. Duolingo allows digital score sending to institutions through your test account. Make sure you select the correct university, campus, and department when sending your result.

Is Duolingo easier than IELTS?

Duolingo is shorter and more flexible, but that does not automatically make it easy. The test is adaptive, which means the difficulty changes based on your performance. Many students find it convenient, but strong vocabulary, listening, speaking, and writing skills still matter.

Final Thoughts

Duolingo accepted universities in USA give international students more flexibility than before. You can take the test online, receive results quickly, and apply to a wide range of US universities without waiting for a traditional test date.

But the smart move is not simply choosing Duolingo because it is convenient. The smart move is matching your score with the right university list.

If your score is 95–105, focus on universities and pathways whose published requirements match that range. If your score is 110–120, your shortlist becomes stronger. If you are aiming for Ivy League, top private universities, or competitive master’s programmes, note that several current benchmarks now sit at 130–135+, while some institutions use no fixed DET minimum.

A good Duolingo score can open doors. A well-matched university list helps you walk through the right one.
